clips.title: The story
paras: Raptors prowl Black Channel Marsh beside the road to Menethil Harbor. The mire lies in the Wetlands’ southwest, where travelers and couriers face danger along the coast.

Black Channel Marsh spreads across the low ground southwest of the main road to Menethil Harbor. Caravan drivers and couriers know the danger there. The raised road may seem safe, but territorial raptors live among the stagnant channels and thick reeds. Hungry beasts often stray into the road, ambushing recruits and weary travelers who wander even a little from the path.
